content: Word vector space alignment has most frequently been explored in the context of cross-lingual word embeddings. For instance, BIBREF10 align English and Spanish Word2Vec spaces by a simple linear transformation. BIBREF11 use a related method to align cross-lingual word vectors and multilingual BERT wordpiece vectors.
